description: Contraintes résiduelles prospectives sur le RPT à horizon 3 à 5 ans (à décembre 2024) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce registre présente une vision prospective de 3 à 5 ans des contraintes résiduelles prospectives sur le Réseau de Transport d’Électricité des différentes régions de France métropolitaine, hors Corse. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Territoires et régions, Infrastructures. The portal shows 2025-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
